title: Channel Hold by Payment Channel: Crestline Credit Card Directed Payments
content:
A channel hold applies to today's payment on a Crestline Credit Card account when the cardholder directs it to a deferred-interest plan: when it came in online, 0.1 is added to the held share of the amount reaching the plan; when it came in by phone, 0.05 is added; otherwise nothing is added.

**Record read:** the payment channel of today's payment on the card ledger (the latest payment posted today).

| Today's payment came in | Added to the held share |
|---|---|
| online | 0.1 (10 percent) |
| by phone (automated or live) | 0.05 (5 percent) |
| by mail, in store or autopay | nothing |

Hypothetical case: 260.00 USD reaching the plan from a payment made online, with nothing else held — 26.00 USD is kept back and 234.00 USD reaches the plan.
